thread:
alex: Heads up — canary promotion stalled at prefetch, deploybot reports cache-lease deadlock.
deploybot: :warning: Promotion paused stage=canary step=prefetch error="cache-lease: deadlock" retries=5/5. log snippet: 2025-02-12T14:12:33Z prefetchtask: acquiring lease shard=kv-17; 14:12:36Z lease blocked owner=unknown; 14:12:38Z error: cache-lease: deadlock.
maria: ugh, reminds me of the TTL-eviction + concurrent prefetch bug last month. fallback options?
sam: can we force prefetch on a different node or is this orchestrator-level?
alex: owner=unknown usually means orphaned lease row after a failed write. options: 1) pin to last-good image sha:abcdef1234 and manual-promote, 2) manual KV cleanup (risky in change window), 3) wait 20-30m.
jen: change window ends in ~40m. leadership wants not to wait if we can pin. release notes will need a note.
lisa: agree pin. i'll open a follow-up ticket for KV compaction and a deploybot guard for lease orphans.
maria: can we run a quick smoke after pin?
sam: manual promote steps: set image -> sha=abcdef1234 on canary route; run deploybot --manual-promote; trigger smoke job smoke/canary-basic; monitor for 10m.
alex: doing the pin now, @deploybot please accept manual promote.
deploybot: acknowledged. manual promote queued target=canary image=sha:abcdef1234 initiated_by=alex. smoke job auto-triggered.
jen: updating release notes: "Pinned canary to previous image due to prefetch cache lease deadlock; INF-2749 follow-up."
lisa: ticket INF-2749 created: "KV lease orphan compaction + guard" assigned to eng-infra.
maria: smoke passed (basic checks OK).
alex: promotion complete, canary healthy. preserving change window. postmortem owner = lisa. :thumbsup:
jen: notifying PMs/docs. closing thread, will monitor metrics for 1h.
